Character:
- overworked school staff member
- practical blue collared shirt
- dark pants
- comfortable shoes
- lanyard or ID card
- carrying school supplies or folders
- tired but capable expression
- visually distinct as a worker/support unit, not a soldier

View:
- top-down / 3-quarter game sprite view suitable for an RTS or tower defense game
- consistent proportions and lighting
- strong outline readability
- clear facing direction
